analysis: The supplied changes to docs/developer/build.md are documentation-only. The visible hunks update the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and revise the CI workflow table and hourly dev run section (base lines 360-395, head 360-396). The patch excerpt is truncated, so I could not see the full rewrite. The rows visible in the base text describe ci-dev.yml, ci-master.yml, ci-dev-hourly.yml, the dispatch-triggered Report hourly failures job with issues: write, and the dev-branch cache and route behavior. This is CI and build documentation. I saw no change to provider source, coordinator-to-provider wire handling, attestation, authorization, encryption or key custody, cache storage, or the fan, hold-socket, sandbox or GPU-limit boundaries. I therefore found no regression against the ADV, A, TB or T entries in the canonical threat model; T-041 was supplied, but no prefix-cache code or doc claim changed in the visible hunks. Remaining questions: the hourly-run section appears to be removed or relocated in the head version (the patch shows deletions of the dispatch-based hourly text and the head range extends one line further), and the head text was not supplied. A reviewer should confirm that any workflow files (.github/workflows/ci-dev-hourly.yml, ci-dev.yml, darkbloom-route.yml) changed alongside this doc do not weaken the controls the base doc describes. Those controls are the issues: write scope limited to the failure report job, the cache gating on Darkbloom sandboxes (CI_ACTIONS_CACHE=off), and release and signing runs keeping literal Blacksmith labels. Those workflows are outside this batch, so they are an unverified contract and not a finding.
